reviews.title: Good planner
reviews.text: I’m 71 and trying to lose weight and get off some of my meds.  So far I’ve lost 25 pounds, dropped my A1C from 8.6 to 6.4, and my glucose from 188 to 112.  Of course, I use my treadmill, free weights, walking at the mall, and this app.  It may not be the heart and soul of my change; but, it was my god’s honest starting point and a stability in my daily routine.  Well worth the annual fee; but, don’t take my word for it, get the free trial and use it every day during the trial, if you feel different afterwards, subscribe.

reviews.title: Very user friendly
reviews.text:
I’ve been using the Muscle Fit Chair Tai Chi program for six weeks, and I’m genuinely impressed with the results. I signed up for the yearly plan because I wanted something sustainable that I could stick with, and it has exceeded my expectations.

The exercises are easy to follow, gentle on my body, and surprisingly effective. By week six, I’m already noticing more definition in my abdominal muscles, along with improved core strength, balance, and flexibility. I actually look forward to each session because it’s both relaxing and energizing.

If you’re looking for a low-impact fitness program that delivers real results while helping you feel stronger and healthier, I highly recommend giving Muscle Fit Chair Tai Chi a try. I’m excited to see where I’ll be by the end of the year!
